issue.body:
<!-- graphgoblin-delivery:2026-11-14 -->
**Engineering delivered (2026-11-14):** [PR #474](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/474) merged as `8fadcb0d44ac2caf80ff6279fe4648ce9398afd9`. Its tree is exactly the verified publication tree `8b7cd8d131917ce74da0d8b7a684317477be22ce`, with parents current main `a817e5cc` and head `b1810e03`.

All three formal scans are consumed. The historical final Astra scan found A1/A2; both were corrected, root-inspected and independently verified. The [final capped completion disposition](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/pull/474#issuecomment-6885894689) applies D-035/D-042 after green exact-head/current-target CI. It is not a fourth scan or a fresh Astra sign-off, and no known in-scope blocker was waived.

[CI](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43651091055) and [routing](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/actions/runs/43651091052) passed all five jobs on their first attempts: 22 coverage tasks, web 2,546 tests/207 files, domain 459/29, Browser 479 plus one expected live-provider skip/zero retries, Windows 14/14 and template-image checks. The high-severity audit threshold passed with eight low/thirteen moderate advisories.

Independent final native verification used the compiled API, file SQLite and actual Edge input. Computed-key repair and known-missing refusal passed both groups/26 HTTP operations while prior releases and pins stayed exact. The first valid self-rename Add/Remove/Boolean activation, cancellation, duplicate-ID refusal and Tab/Space passed eight cases/41 checkpoints/29 conditional PUTs including history. All 68 source hashes, 17 embedded modules and 1,227 built artifacts across 13 trees remained exact; both disposable fixtures closed cleanly. [Final evidence and root inspection](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/b1810e03402cbc5d1bdceac899dbcc40b1ac317e/docs/qa/2026-11-14-node-reference-final-independent/README.md)

**Owner product acceptance remains open.** This issue is parked in backlog to prevent repeat engineering pickup. On an installed build containing the merge, judge whether repair summaries and uncertainty guidance are understandable, warning navigation is predictable, and preserved editing/focus feels right during ordinary authoring. Machine-checkable repair, refusal, history and immutable-release behavior belong to the pipeline and are verified above. No owner acceptance or whole-I08 completion is inferred.

Nonblocking follow-ups #476/#477 remain open. Earlier source snapshots and negative review/QA evidence remain historical and unchanged.

**Owner-approved consolidated revision, 2026-10-18. Implementation remains held by #279.** Latest owner decisions in #278 supersede older proposals and historical comments. This approval authorizes backlog publication only; no implementation, owner-environment change, or provider run is dispatched.

Authority and complete owner decision record: #278. Current text supersedes older model proposals and historical scheduling/approval statements; comments remain historical evidence, not a competing current specification.

## Bounded change

Repair understood node-ID references

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Rename updates structurally understood references atomically; known broken references block publication, dynamic uncertainty is explained and unrelated strings are unchanged.

- [x] Repair only references whose structure is understood; do not blindly replace node-ID text inside arbitrary scripts, prompts or JSON.

## Verification

Expressions/templates/structured references supported by current contract, undo/save/reload and intentional ambiguous strings.

## Dependencies

- #281 — X-EDITOR
- #279 — implementation dispatch remains held.

## Scope limits

Only the described behavior and its necessary tests/contracts/docs.

## Delivery and closure

Approved plan; parked pending explicit dispatch. Proposed implementer: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh; independent reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh; independent QA: GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh. QA scope: touched systems, including relevant positive, negative, concurrency, cancellation and restart cases. All tests use supported interfaces; retain existing coverage protections.

**Owner product acceptance required before closure.** PRs use Part of rather than auto-closing this issue until the owner has accepted the running behavior.

No implementation gate labels are applied now. After later dispatch, select the repository gate consistent with owner-review requirements; never combine aidlc-ready and human-in-the-loop.

The observations below describe their original assessed baseline. They are not current solution requirements; the approved scope above controls. Reproduce on the accepted target before relying on them.
